label: caiso 36 midday convexity
definition: (PROBE - REJECTED, not a keeper; caiso 35 remains the keeper) Tested the hypothesis that caiso 35's CA-zone LMP over-price is the reference-seam price being too smooth midday: deepened the WECC seam net-load convexity (DSW exp 1.0->2.5; PNW gross->net exp 1.5), lowered the midday floor to a small negative, dropped the inflated partial-coverage 2023 hr_by_year. RESULT: the body did NOT improve (CA-zone LMP 98.7/69.7/75.3 vs actual 43.8/33.0/33.6; 744 h >$200 in 2023 unchanged) and interchange REGRESSED (2023 err +3.56->+8.49 TWh; 2024 +2.78->-4.95 flip to under-import; 2024 diurnal r 0.93->0.49). DIAGNOSIS: the body over-price is DOMESTIC, not the seam - midday the marginal unit is economic gas_cc bidding ~89 (implied HR ~25 = fuel + P1 startup-amort + reserve co-opt), with NO model midday solar surplus (solar fully used, CA still needs 6.5 GW gas_cc), and the model already imports ~4x the measured midday volume. Source reverted to caiso 35. See results/calibration/DIAGNOSIS-caiso36-body-overprice-domestic-2026-06-28.md.
